thread:
alisa: starting canary for tinker14b-int4. observed rapid mem-fragmentation and a few OOMs under standard batch=4, max_new_tokens=256. convo evals show small drop in answer F1 vs fp16. attaching quick notes.
ben: paste logs? any stack traces or eviction chatter?
alisa: logs:
```
[2026-03-20T09:04:12Z] WARN memory: high fragmentation detected (frag_score=0.73)
[2026-03-20T09:04:12Z] ERROR cuda: out of memory allocating 1.6 GiB
[2026-03-20T09:04:12Z] INFO kv: evicted 240 entries, reclaimed 18 MiB
[2026-03-20T09:04:13Z] INFO runtime: falling back to tinker14b-int8 for some requests
```
marta: sounds like int4 fused kernels are allocating per-layer temp buffers. two quick mitigations: reduce `batch_size` to 1-2 for canary, set `max_new_tokens=96`, and disable aggressive prefetch. also enable `slot_compaction` and set `kv_evict_threshold=0.25`.
ben: +1. Also suggest `idle_kv_eviction=30s` so long-lived but cold sessions don't hold slots.
alisa: applying patch to canary: `batch_size=2`, `max_new_tokens=96`, `prefetch=false`, `slot_compaction=true`, `kv_evict_threshold=0.25`, `idle_kv_eviction=30s`. rolling to canary-2.
infra-bot: canary deployed: cluster-canary-2, image=inference:v2.5-tinker-canary, nodes=4
ben: run the micro-eval and mem-stress harness: `./tools/onboard_smoke.sh --model tinker14b:int4 --seq 1024 --iter 200` and post p95/p99 lat + OOM count.
alisa: quick smoke (20m): OOMs=0, p95 latency +18ms vs fp16 baseline, p99 spikes rare, F1 delta -0.9. throughput down ~30%.
marta: acceptable short term tradeoffs. long term: schedule a kernel audit to reduce scratch, attempt per-layer hybrid quant (keep attention accumulators in int8), and run a small quant-retrain or calibration to recover quality.
ben: I'll add a Canary Checklist test to run onboard_smoke for new int4 models and assert frag_score < 0.6.
alisa: noted — I'll add the reduced defaults to model-catalog for tinker14b-int4 and document the fallback path. thanks all :thumbsup:
